name: sounio-epistemic
description: Core epistemic types: Knowledge<T>, Contest<T>, Robust<T>, Validated<T>. Uncertainty propagation, measurement, and proof-carrying values.

name: sounio-causal
description: Causal inference primitives: do-calculus, d-separation checking, intervention types, counterfactual witnesses. Integrates with the epistemic type system.

name: sounio-stats
description: Statistical tools with first-class uncertainty: Bayesian MCMC, Monte Carlo, Sobol sequences, covariance propagation, and GUM-compliant error budgets.

name: sounio-units
description: Compile-time dimensional analysis. Prevents unit mismatch errors at type-check time. Supports SI, pharmacokinetic, and custom unit systems.

name: sounio-math
description: Pure mathematics: quaternion algebra, octonion arithmetic, linear algebra over Knowledge<T>, and autodifferentiation with epistemic bounds.

name: sounio-ml
description: Machine learning building blocks with epistemic uncertainty: Gaussian processes, quaternion neural networks, loss functions, and tensor operations.

name: sounio-graph
description: Graph algorithms with epistemic annotations: entropy, curvature, coherence measures, and null-model testing for network analysis.

name: sounio-darwin-pbpk
description: Physiologically-based pharmacokinetic (PBPK) modelling with Sounio epistemic types. Compartment models for liver, kidney; drug-drug interaction support.

name: sounio-search
description: Search algorithms: Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) with uncertainty-aware rollouts, basic search, and pattern matching.

name: sounio-gpu
description: GPU kernel authoring and dispatch. Write GPU kernels in Sounio syntax; compile to PTX or Metal MSL. Includes fractal and tensor kernel examples.
